sql: SELECT pm.lane_role AS lane_role, count(*) AS n, avg((((pm.player_slot < 128) = m.radiant_win))::int)::float8 AS win_rate, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pm.gold_per_min) AS median_gold_per_min FROM player_matches pm JOIN matches m USING (match_id) JOIN match_patch mp USING (match_id) WHERE mp.patch = '7.41' AND pm.hero_id = 44 GROUP BY pm.lane_role ORDER BY n DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100
